topic: The hidden cost of the quick question: how task switching and interruptions eat focused work, and what teams can do about it

request.audience: knowledge workers and managers in corporate teams
request.notes: Editorial, magazine-like explainer. Numbers only if well established; otherwise use clearly hypothetical framing. Show the cost with data as objects (stamped unit grids, piles, a held slot that swaps). Practical close: two or three team habits.
